description: Progress Icon - Turn Any Metric Into a Visual Story Progress Icon is a clean, modern Power BI custom visual that makes KPI reporting instantly intuitive. Instead of another number on a card, your audience sees a meaningful icon - a dollar sign, a trophy, a clock - filling up as performance approaches its target. At a glance, everyone knows where things stand. WHY PROGRESS ICON? Native Power BI KPI cards show numbers. Progress Icon shows meaning. The visual fill animation communicates momentum, urgency, and achievement without a single extra label - making your dashboards self-explanatory for any audience, from C-suite to frontline teams. KEY FEATURES - Icon Fill Progress: Fills any SVG icon vertically to reflect Value/Benchmark percent. - KPI Visualization: Instantly shows “progress toward target” instead of just numbers. - Dynamic Label: Displays actual vs. target values and percentage below the icon. - Custom Icons: Choose from 15+ built-in icons or upload your own SVG for any use case. - Responsive Design: Scales icon and fill smoothly on dashboards; works well in small cards. - Conditional Coloring: Optionally color the icon based on value thresholds (e.g. green/yellow/red). - Tooltips: Hover to see exact values COMMON USE CASES - Sales Performance: Actual Revenue vs. Target → Dollar icon fills to 78% - Project Completion: Tasks Done vs. Total Tasks → Check-Circle icon…
